title: Schedules

assign.title: Assign schedule
assign.description: Assign a schedule to many people at once.
assign.dragHint: Drag people onto the schedule on the right
assign.removeHint: Drag an assigned person here to remove them

overtime.title: Overtime
overtime.description: Time worked after the scheduled exit. One row per person in the period.
overtime.totalsNote: The totals above cover the full period (everyone matching the filter), not just this page.

help.title: How to read this report?
help.intro: Each row is one person in the period. The totals above sum everyone matching the filter, not just this page.
help.extra: Time worked after the scheduled exit, minus the exit tolerance. It only counts if it reaches the minimum configured in the schedule (60 min by default); above the minimum, exact minutes are counted. Clocking in early does not generate overtime.
help.worked: Total time on site (entry to exit). Includes meals and breaks.
help.scheduled: Hours set by the schedule on days the person did clock in. That's why it can be less than hours worked.
help.daysWithExtra: Number of days in the period with overtime. Not the number of clock-ins.
help.noSchedule: The person has no schedule assigned in the period, so no overtime is calculated.
help.missing: Difference when the person worked less than scheduled. Included in the CSV, not in the table.
help.restDay: If they clock in on a rest day, all time worked counts as overtime, as long as it reaches the schedule's minimum.
help.scope: The report only includes people with at least one clock-in in the period.
help.dash: “—” means there was no overtime in the period.

secondHint: Enable it on days with a split shift (e.g. housekeeping or restaurant).
